title: The Ground Beneath the Runners
description: At the spring festival footrace, the red clay lifts at the finish. Five runners race uphill as the lanes curl open like ribbons.
alt: Five runners sprint along a red clay track whose lanes curl into the blue sky above the finish posts. Yellow wildflowers fill the foreground and spectators watch from the hillside.
pairing: An imagined spring games festival × a running track that curls into the sky
